  "memo":"R03 holds: the US IP differs from the IN card issuer, and CVV failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule condition holds. No household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate customer using a previously used foreign-issued card remains plausible, but familiar device and card history do not establish authorization. With no completed checks, recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), carried out as a hold with id_check. Contact is not required. The order has already shipped, so verification cannot pause shipment or prevent the existing exposure; its outcome will determine the subsequent disposition."
